title: Classical capacities and complementary simulation for qubit Davies channels
prior_involvement: Same reviewer audited candidate-1, manuscript-1, manuscript-2, entanglement dossiers and the complementary-cost dossiers, and supplied clarifications and computational diagnostics used in the integrated text/supplement. This is an expanded exact-version follow-up, not a new independent vote.
recommendation_scope: Mathematically sound working paper under its explicit triangular-entropy dependency; not journal/AIRR acceptance, human peer review, formal-proof verification or worldwide priority certification.
technical_quality_basis: Complete and coherently integrated finite-dimensional proofs; correct reverse normalization, arbitrary partners, state/channel distinction, operational regularization, singular cases and attribution; exact supplement adaptations validated and reproducible. No material mathematical objection found.
importance_scale_definition: 3 acceptable/substantive;4 strong;5 very good;6 excellent;7 exceptional;8 potentially field-shaping;9 potentially historic;10 unconditional recognized Millennium Prize solution surviving extraordinary independent verification
importance_basis: Excellent as a focused communication-and-simulation result for the stated nonunital Davies family. The added complementary parallel-cost theorem, sufficient rate regimes and rigorous channel/Choi-cost separation give substantive operational utility beyond the preceding capacity/state version. The mechanism still extends recent thermal machinery and uses established roof/reversal/simulation results, with substantial known subcases; exceptional or field-shaping importance is not established.

correctness_confidence.basis: All stated arguments checked under the declared external theorem; no invalid quantifier, entropy direction or operational inference found.

rigor.basis: Attainment, marginal roofs, support lifting, reverse-channel closure, singular inputs, arbitrary partners and regularization are explicit and correct.

novelty.basis: Specific useful nonunital Davies extension with further operational consequences; recent and established ingredients and the unital/epolarizing overlaps are credited. Global priority is unverified.

significance.basis: Unified capacity, all-range state formation/cost and complementary parallel simulation for a physical channel family, with an exact non-Bell example; broader general-channel and adaptive questions remain open.

reproducibility.basis: All 28 payload hashes verified; three adapted-script output JSON files reproduce byte-for-byte and the independent cost script reproduces every mathematical field. Unchanged prior artifacts are verified by hash; numerical limitations are clearly stated.

summary: The exact 15-page manuscript is mathematically sound under its declared triangular-entropy dependency. It successfully integrates complementary channel-formation additivity and parallel cost, correct sufficient closed/plateau regimes, and an exact strict separation from Choi-state cost. Prior-art attribution and operational boundaries are adequate. Technical quality is 9.0/10; AIRR importance is 6.0/10. This is the same involved reviewer, not an additional independent assessment.
strengths: Sharp fixed-entropy three-vertex block extension with a valid controlled-purification proof.
Full arbitrary-input convex-roof superadditivity and all-range state formation/cost.
A distinct reverse-range argument correctly transfers a strongly additive optimizing state to complementary channel formation and parallel simulation.
Rigorous rational non-Bell example proves strict channel-cost versus Choi-state-cost separation.
Existing unital/epolarizing, GAD-boundary, HU and reverse-channel ingredients are explicitly credited.
Frozen inputs, complete readable proofs and reproducible supplementary calculations.
limitations: External Tang/OpenAI triangular-entropy dependency remains; it is not independently reproved here.
Full Stinespring complementary output, not necessarily only the accessible thermal bath.
Parallel LOCC diamond-norm simulation; no general adaptive/sequential cost for the nonunital family.
No result for the original channel simulation cost, quantum/private capacity or higher-dimensional interacting Davies models.
Sufficient high- and low-coherence regimes, not a complete phase diagram.
No worldwide priority certification, formal proof assistant or interval-certified general numerical solver.
Same involved AI reviewer; no blind or independent additional vote and no runtime identity attestation.

validation.numerical_scope: Only adapted/packaged simulation scripts rerun. Previous large block, partner, scalar capacity and entanglement tests reused by hash, not counted as new independent samples. The independent cost samples rerun here are also the same previously audited seed, not new samples.
